title: access.approved data (v1)
description: CloudEvents `data` payload for `com.governauthzer.access.approved`. Means: ADD this grant — provision the user into the role on the target application. This schema describes the `data` member only; the surrounding CloudEvents envelope is fixed by the CloudEvents 1.0 spec. Additive fields may appear in future without a version bump, so consumers MUST ignore unknown properties.

access_id.description: The governauthzer access (grant) this event concerns. A correlation handle; the access row itself is not part of the contract.

user.description: The subject of the grant. Resolving this to a target-system account is the bridge's job.

id.description: Immutable governauthzer user id. KEY YOUR PERSISTENT USER -> TARGET-ACCOUNT MAPPING ON THIS.

email.description: Conventional cross-system match key. Mutable (a rename surfaces on a later event) — use only for FIRST resolution, never as the persistent key.

role.description: The role being granted. One target-system entitlement/group, resolved by the bridge from `slug`.

slug.description: Stable, application-scoped role slug (e.g. `slack-admin`). The bridge maps this to the target entitlement.

application.description: The target system the role belongs to. Connectors partition by application.
